cover.report_type: Amendment (no Type-of-Report box checked); hand-written header 'June 2008 Amendment'

_meta.notes: Same FORM/LABEL pattern as the other Horiuchi amendments: a 2012-vintage blank hand-titled 'June 2008 Amendment' on the cover and 'June 2008' on the Summary Page, signed and filed 2/14/13. NO Type-of-Report box is checked; only the amendment 'Yes' box with date of report 2/14/13. Line 2 Column A writes the cents as a raised superscript crammed at the cell edge ('45,153' with superscript '55'); line 6 prints the same figure plainly as 45,153.55, confirming the reading. Line 3 (22,457.41) chains from the April amendment's line 7. Arithmetic checks: 22,457.41 + 41,200 = 63,657.41 and 63,657.41 - 45,153.55 = 18,503.86.

itemized.itemized_pages_B: 4,5,6 (handwritten Schedule B form pages, OUT OF ORDER - see notes)

contributions.detail: exact (41200 = 41,200). 49 attachment rows sum to the attachment's printed 'Total Contributions Received: 41200', which equals the Summary Page figure

expenditures.detail: exact (45153.55 = 45,153.55). 36 rows across three Schedule B pages; every page subtotal gates and the three subtotals sum to the printed TOTAL

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Schedule A attachment prints no per-page subtotal, only a grand total, which gates exactly (49 rows = 41,200). Schedule B: PDF p4 rows sum 26,775.91 = printed SUBTOTAL 26,775.91 (PASS); PDF p5 rows sum 8,622.51 = printed SUBTOTAL 8,622.51 (PASS); PDF p6 rows sum 9,755.13 = printed SUBTOTAL 9,755.13 (PASS). 26,775.91 + 8,622.51 + 9,755.13 = 45,153.55 = the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE on p6 and the Summary Page. The p6 gate is what ADJUDICATED the Home Depot amount as 51.14 (a 51.19 reading breaks the subtotal by exactly 0.05)
itemized.escalation_note: no cell crop was needed; the p6 page-subtotal gate resolved the only doubtful digit (Home Depot 51.14 vs 51.19)
itemized.notes: Randy Horiuchi, County Council, JUNE 2008 amendment (form header hand-dated 'June 16/08' with 'amend 2/14/13' added). MIXED PAGE ORIENTATIONS in one document: PDF p3 (the Schedule A spreadsheet attachment) is LANDSCAPE and must be rotated 90 degrees CLOCKWISE, while PDF p4/p5/p6 (handwritten Schedule B form pages) are rendered UPSIDE-DOWN (180 degrees) by poppler. SCHEDULE B PAGES ARE OUT OF ORDER in the PDF: p4 = form 'Page 1 of 3', p5 = form 'Page 2 of 3', p6 = form 'Page 3 of 3' (p6 carries the grand TOTAL) - the page-number boxes, not the PDF order, establish the sequence, and all three subtotals gate. SCHEDULE A has NO Date column at all, so every contribution row has an empty date by structural absence; its Address/City/State/Zip columns exist but are ENTIRELY BLANK on the sheet (no data, and no black redaction bar either), so donor_city/donor_state are blank by source. Names are printed Last, First and are recorded here as 'First Last'; entity rows have no first name. Three contribution rows have an empty Occupation/Employer cell. Schedule B geometry is OMITTED (empty string) rather than guessed - the 180-degree pages' row bands were not measured to per-row precision, and a wrong pointer is worse than none; Schedule A geometry is measured (row pitch detected from the sheet) and converted back to the portrait orientation, so each row is a narrow VERTICAL strip.
